# Test fixtures

`navarrete2018_njp.pdf` is the published version of

> Á. Navarrete, W. Wang, F. Xu and M. Curty, "Characterizing multi-photon quantum interference with
> practical light sources and threshold single-photon detectors", *New J. Phys.* **20**, 043018 (2018),
> https://doi.org/10.1088/1367-2630/aab746

© 2018 The Author(s), published by IOP Publishing Ltd on behalf of Deutsche Physikalische Gesellschaft,
under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), as the
paper itself states.

Changes made here: the publisher's cover sheet (which carries the IP address and time of the download)
was removed, and the file's metadata was reduced to title, author, journal reference and keywords. The
article itself is unchanged. It is used by `tests/test_ingest_journal.py` to test the reading of a
typeset journal layout (Symbol-font codes, equations split over many blocks, front matter).
